_comment: Hand-verified opt-out endpoints. priority 5 = highest impact (widely scraped or feeds other brokers). method: web_form | email | web_form_captcha | account_required | postal | phone. Merged with the Optery list by scripts/build_registry.py

brokers.name: 411 Com
brokers.notes: support@whitepages.com is an unmonitored autoresponder that redirects to a Zendesk form, despite being the address peoplesearch.com publishes as its privacy contact. privacyrequest@whitepages.com opens a real ticket.

brokers.name: AcademixDirect
brokers.notes: Confirmed a removal without a direct request from us - reached them via downstream propagation from a lead-network request. Education lead generation.

brokers.name: Acxiom
brokers.notes: Major aggregator - feeds many downstream brokers.

brokers.name: Adttribution
brokers.notes: Site publishes hello@adttribution.com; info@adttribution.com is more privacy-specific but appears nowhere on the site. Try the alternate if this goes unanswered. Registry keeps info@adttribution.com (purpose-built for this request type); the site publishes hello@adttribution.com, retained as a fallback.

brokers.name: Aged Lead Store
brokers.notes: Aged Lead Store = Next Wave Marketing Strategies Inc, 15527 Jasmine Place, Tustin CA 92782, 888-238-9283. optout@nextwavemarketingstrategies.com HARD BOUNCES (550) despite being the address published in broker directories - use privacy_requests@ or customercare@ from their own privacy policy. California-based, so CCPA applies directly.

brokers.name: Citydata
brokers.notes: Published privacy@citydata.ai is a Google Workspace group closed to external posting and bounces ('the group you tried to contact (privacy) may not exist, or you may not have permission to post'). Use dpo@citydata.ai from their privacy page instead. privacy@citydata.ai is published in the policy but is a Google Workspace group closed to external senders - it rejects consumer mail. Use dpo@.

brokers.name: DatabaseUSA
brokers.notes: Found because infofree.com links its privacy route here. Runs a self-service portal at privacycompliance.biz with separate toggles for opt-out of sale, deletion and category disclosure, and an emailed verification link. Their disclosure page lists ethnicity, religion and political party among the categories collected, and 'Resale to Data Brokers' among the purposes.

brokers.name: Dtn
brokers.notes: privacy@dtn.com is NOT a consumer route: its autoresponder states that privacy requests sent there 'will not be processed and will be deleted'. Use the Data Rights Exercise Request form, or call 1-800-485-4000.

brokers.name: Dun & Bradstreet
brokers.notes: TrustArc-hosted rights portal. The bare submit-irm.trustarc.eu host returns 400 - the full validation path with D&B's UUID is required. Found via their privacy policy, not their homepage.

brokers.name: Enformion
brokers.notes: UPSTREAM SOURCE behind SearchPeopleFREE (EnformionGO API). UPSTREAM SOURCE. Discovered via SearchPeopleFREE, which advertises EnformionGO as the partner API behind its data. Removing from downstream sites does not touch Enformion, so records re-populate. High priority as an upstream aggregator.
